scope: Phase 2 opt-in internal static compiler pipeline on local CPU

derivation.latency: max(1.25 ms, approximately 2 * measured legacy_plan p95), rounded up to a reviewable boundary
derivation.memory: at least 2 * measured legacy_plan peak with explicit fixed-overhead allowance, rounded up
derivation.comparison_scope: CircuitIR import, verification, approved Phase 2 passes, restricted lowering, and verification of the lowered result
derivation.default_path: zero new-path work unless an internal explicit opt-in is supplied

additional_gates.semantic_parity: inherit the per-oracle dtype and backend tolerances from the Phase 0 manifest; no global tolerance
additional_gates.determinism: exact output identity and pipeline digest across repeated runs
additional_gates.gradient: forward and gradient parity for every parameter-rewriting pass
additional_gates.default_runtime_regression: zero new-path imports or work without explicit internal opt-in
additional_gates.budget_changes: require new measured evidence and owner review; never auto-update to pass CI
